ztb.config.schema module

Configuration schemas using Pydantic for type safety and validation.

This module defines the configuration models for various components of the trading system.

Module contents

Configuration management system for Zaif Trade Bot.

This module provides centralized configuration management with support for: - YAML configuration files - Environment variable overrides - Configuration validation and type safety - Dynamic configuration reloading
